commit.messageHeadline: fix: sandboxed sessions cannot edit managed projects
fix(sandbox): fence retired workspace effects and preserve cleanup ow…
fix(sandbox): preserve guest teardown and selected project directories
fix(sandbox): preserve runtime recovery on current main
fix(codex): reject retained input after workspace revocation
test(skills): report stalled watcher settlement phases
fix(sandbox): retain runtime generations through workspace retirement
chore: reconcile sandbox wrapper dependencies with main
